_info: Post-session radio conversations. D = driver, RE = race engineer (English). {d} driver short name, {p} position, {e} engineer, {cele}/{cele2} = podium celebration in the team's national language (from countries.json). Add more variants to any list for more variety.

calm: Pole position! The car felt perfect on that lap, thank you guys.
Fantastic, {d}. P1 on the grid, you have earned it.
I cannot believe it, everything came together.
Beautiful lap, {d}. Now let us finish the job tomorrow.
The balance was spot on, I could attack every corner.
Copy, {d}. Pole position, well done to the whole crew.
normal: Pole! That was a clean one, I am really happy.
Great job, {d}. Let us keep the same car for the race.
I gave it everything on that last lap.
It shows, {d}. P1. Enjoy this one.
Good lap, the car was great in the high speed corners.
Copy that. We are proud of you, {d}.

calm: Good lap, the car felt balanced today. P{p}, nice.
Well done, {d}. We will keep the same setup for tomorrow.
Happy with that. Maybe a tenth left in the last sector.
Copy. Strong session, {d}, P{p} is a good place to start.
The car was lovely on the soft tyres.
Great, {d}. We will look at the long run data tonight.
normal: Decent session. I think there was a little more in the car, though.
Copy that. We will check the data and find where you can gain it.
P{p}. I lost a bit in the final chicane.
Understood. It is a solid result, {d}, we can work with it.
Traffic cost me on the out lap, but the pace is there.
Ok, noted. The car is good, {d}, stay focused.
rage: P{p}?! I had the pole lap, the car snapped on the last corner!
Understood, {d}. We will look into the rear stability. Great job anyway.
I had traffic everywhere! This was not my lap!
Copy, {d}. We will talk to the team about the timing.
The car just would not rotate in the last sector, what is this?!
Ok, we will find it out. Calm down, P{p} is still strong.

calm: P{p}. The car is okay, just lacking a bit of top speed.
Copy. We will look at the wing levels for the race.
P{p}. We are close, just lacking a bit of traction.
Copy. We will work on the diff settings for the race.
Not the best, but the tyres were not in the window.
Understood, {d}. We will have a better plan tomorrow.
normal: The balance is not quite there. Understeer into the slow corners.
Ok, we will find it out and adjust for the race.
The car is a bit nervous on entry.
Copy, we will look at the front wing and brake balance.
I feel there is more in the car than P{p}.
Agreed. Let us go through the data together.
rage: This car has no grip! Every lap I am fighting it!
Copy, {d}. Keep calm, we will find out what is going on.
P{p}! We are miles off, what is going on with this car?!
Copy, {d}. Stay calm, we will go through everything.
I am driving on the limit and still nothing! Fix the car!

calm: Tough session. We are missing pace everywhere.
Understood. We will go through the data tonight and fix it.
We just do not have the pace today. I tried everything.
I know, {d}. Thank you for pushing. We will bounce back.
It was a difficult lap, no confidence in the car.
Copy. We will work on the balance for tomorrow.
normal: P{p}... the car just won't turn. I can't carry any speed.
Ok, we will find it out. Race pace is what matters now.
P{p}. The car has no rear grip at all.
Ok, we will find it out. Keep your head up.
I could not get the tyres working, lap after lap.
Understood, {d}. We will review the tyre preparation.
rage: What is this car?! It is undriveable! P{p} is a joke!
Copy, {d}. I hear you. We will find the problem, I promise.
This is embarrassing! The car is not competitive at all!
Copy, {d}. I hear you. Let us talk after the session.
I am pushing like crazy and the car does nothing!
Understood. We will find the problem, {d}.

calm: Brilliant drive, {d}! P1, you have made the whole team proud.
Copy that, {d}, and what a race it was! Enjoy this one, you deserve it.
Congratulations, {d}! The car and the strategy were perfect today.
normal: That is a victory for everyone back at the factory, {d}. Proud of you.
P1, {d}! Cool down lap now, soak it all in.
Well done, {d}. Wins like this are why we do everything we do.

calm: Great job, {d}! P{p}, a podium for the team.
Copy, {d}. Fantastic drive, we are all very proud of you.
Well done, {d}. Enjoy the podium, you earned it.
normal: P{p}, {d}! The whole team is celebrating back here.
Good race, {d}. That is a proud moment for all of us.
Brilliant, {d}. Podium finish, thank you for everything.

calm: P{p}. Solid points, the tyres held up well.
Good job, {d}. Points for the team.
Decent day, we kept it clean and scored.
I could have gone faster at the end, but P{p} is fine.
Copy. Good job, {d}, we will look for more next time.
normal: I was stuck in traffic the whole race. The car had no pace to pass.
Ok, we will find it out. Thanks for the push.
I got stuck behind a slower car for ages.
Understood. We will look at the strategy, {d}.
The car was ok. I just lacked a bit of top speed.
Copy, we will bring that to the engineers.
rage: I could not overtake anyone! The car is slow on the straights!
Copy, {d}. We will bring upgrades. Good points today.
I got a terrible strategy! Why did we not pit earlier?!
Copy, {d}. We will review it together, calmly.
Every time I got close, the car lost the front. Terrible!
Understood, {d}. We will check the data.

calm: Tough race. The tyres just fell away at the end.
Understood. We will review the tyre data after the race.
No luck today, we were stuck in the midfield.
Copy. We will regroup and come back stronger.
The pace was not there. We need to find more.
normal: No pace today. The car was sliding everywhere.
Ok, we will find it out. Let us reset for next weekend.
The tyres were gone after ten laps.
Understood. We will review the tyre management.
I did everything I could, the car just was not quick enough.
I know, {d}. Thank you, we will improve.
rage: P{p}?! This car is a disaster! I am wasting my time!
Copy, {d}. We hear you. We will work on it, I promise.
What a waste of a weekend! This car is not good enough!
I am driving like crazy and I am still P{p}! Unbelievable!

calm: I have lost power. I have to stop the car.
Copy, {d}. Stop the car safely. We will check what happened.
The engine does not feel right, I have to stop.
Copy {d}. Box this lap, we will check it.
I think it is a brake issue. I cannot continue.
Understood. Stop the car in a safe place.
normal: Something broke at the rear. The car just died.
Ok, bring it into the pits. We will find out what happened.
Gearbox problem, I am losing drive.
Copy. Retire the car, {d}, it is not worth the risk.
There is smoke in the cockpit, something is wrong.
rage: Not again! The car broke AGAIN! What are you doing back there?!
Copy, {d}. I am sorry. We will investigate right away.
Another failure! How many times do I have to retire?!
I am sorry, {d}. We will investigate every part.
I was flying and the car just stopped! Unbelievable!
Copy, {d}. We will find out what happened.

calm: That penalty hurt us. I thought I was within the limits.
Copy. We will look at the onboard and see what happened.
Five seconds, ok. I will try to make it up.
Copy. We will manage the gap, {d}.
I did not see the line, my mistake.
Understood. Stay focused for the rest of the race.
normal: Five seconds, that was harsh. The car was a handful in that corner.
Ok, we will find out why the car slid there.
That felt like a racing incident, to be honest.
Copy. We will check the replay with the stewards.
The penalty was harsh but let us move on.
rage: That penalty is a joke! The car was undriveable out of that corner!
Understood, {d}. We will check it and talk to the stewards.
Are you kidding me?! Everybody does that corner!
Copy, {d}, we will raise it after the race.
This is ridiculous! The stewards are against us!
Calm down, {d}. We will review it.

calm: I was ready, but the car would not start. Disappointing.
Understood, {d}. We will find out what happened in the garage.
I sat in the car and nothing happened.
Copy, {d}. We are sorry, we will investigate.
normal: We never even left the grid. That is painful.
I know, {d}. We will fix it for the next race.
Probably, {d}. The engineers are checking now.
rage: Did not start?! How is this possible at this level?!
I am sorry, {d}. We will have a full review.
I cannot believe it! All weekend work for nothing!
Copy, {d}. We will find the problem, I promise.

calm: Disqualified? That is hard to take, but I understand.
Copy, {d}. We will check the technical report.
I did my job on track. This is out of my hands.
You did, {d}. We will take responsibility.
normal: What happened with the car? Why the DSQ?
We are checking the scrutineering report, {d}.
A disqualification, after all that work...
I know, {d}. We will make sure it does not happen again.
rage: Disqualified?! This is a joke! I drove my heart out!
Copy, {d}. We are sorry, we will investigate.
How can the team get this wrong?! Unacceptable!
You are right to be angry, {d}. We will fix it.
